## Requirements

FR/NFR IDs addressed: 

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated (bad + good fixtures for any new rule)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (types, tests, build, self-scan, package contents, dependency audit)
- [ ] Docs updated (lld.md / configuration.md / known-gaps.md)
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added
- [ ] No contract broken (rule IDs, checklist IDs, JSON schema, flags, exit codes) — or version bump + deprecation noted
- [ ] No secrets or personal data in code or fixtures
- [ ] Code that starts a program, writes a file or prints project text follows "Security-sensitive code" in CONTRIBUTING.md, with a test in `tests/security.test.ts`
- [ ] ADR added if scope or architecture changed
